outcome: incidence of on-treatment severe asthma exacerbations during follow-up

citations.text: This Phase III, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, parallel-group study (GSK study number: FFA114496; clinicaltrials.gov registration number: NCT01431950) was conducted between 12 September 2011 and 03 October 2012.

Other endpoints included change from baseline in Asthma Control Test™ (ACT) score, change in percentage of patients whose asthma was controlled (ACT score ≥ 20) after 24 weeks, incidence of on-treatment severe asthma exacerbations, and incidence of on-treatment unscheduled asthma-related healthcare utilisation.

This was a descriptive study and no formal statistical inference was planned (i.e. no p-values were calculated, but it was planned a priori to calculate treatment differences with associated 95% confidence intervals [CIs] for all efficacy endpoints).

5.1.reasoning: The paper cites a registration but gives no registration date and does not state a pre-specified analysis for severe exacerbations, so there is too little to compare for this outcome.

Severe exacerbations (ATS/ERS taskforce definition [20]) were reported by 13 (12%) patients in the FF 200 μg group and 14 (13%) in the FF 100 μg group.
One patient in the FF 100 μg group experienced a post-treatment severe asthma exacerbation.
